name: 2D Roguelike prototype version 2
author: Ronioskari
description:
2D pixel art roguelike platformer and bad game...

Game might have some bugs, glitches or something else.

Answer my form about the game if you have time...
https://forms.gle/h1DTvqBpd2m77krBA

controls:
- A and D to move left and right.
- Space to jump. (longer you press higher you go)
- Attacks go in the direction of the mouse!!!
- Attack button is mouse 1.
- ESC pauses game and opens window were you can select "exit to mainmenu", "options" (not made yet) and "Give up" (Kills you).
